title: Iowa’s Cancer Explosion is Rattling the Midterms
author: Tamara Bedic
content:
Image by James Baltz. Think “revolution…” and Iowa does not spring to mind– a
stolid, land-locked, agricultural titan, deeply red, where hogs outnumber
voters nearly eight to one. But tariffs have tanked Iowa’s economy. Intensive
farming has depleted half of its rich topsoil. 48 million hogs spew 107
million tons of manure annually– mostly untreated– […]
